verdict.rationale: Any public-facing service with web documentation could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to the CRA. The probes show no llms.txt on canada.ca: https://www.canada.ca/llms.txt redirects to the site's 404 error page. The earlier HTTP 200 reading was that error page reached after following the redirect. Nothing else in the pack points to agent-oriented documentation.
